title: MLEADER nested-text callback publication budget controls
scope: Extend retained-byte tests for MLEADER context text and legacy block-label text through full DXF reads
Prove callback suppression on cap-minus-one refusal and same-facade retry at the measured exact cap
Keep generated ASCII/Binary controls local and use the existing hardening test owner

method.kind: Generated AC1027/AC1021 DXF output followed by file-backed parser callback tests
method.temporaryDrawingPolicy: ASCII/Binary DXF bytes are generated from scratch by the existing test binary, written under a unique temporary directory, and removed after each case.
method.limitations: The test exercises library callback publication and the retained-byte budget only. It does not qualify DWG serialization, arbitrary consumer memory, post-callback mutation, writer/projection-copy accounting, native MLEADER semantics, or binary ABI.

testMatrix.followingSentinel: LINE handle is nonzero; start=(3,4,5), end=(6,7,8)
assertions: Exact-cap full read invokes MLEADER then LINE with exact copied text and coordinates
Cap-minus-one returns ResourceLimit/dxf-retained-byte-budget before either callback
Raising the same facade to the measured cap permits retry and publishes both callbacks in order

testMatrix.route: MLEADER legacy block-label group 302 with group-330 label identities
testMatrix.followingSentinel: LINE handle is nonzero; start=(3,4,5), end=(6,7,8)
assertions: Exact-cap full read invokes MLEADER then LINE with both exact copied label strings and coordinates
Cap-minus-one returns ResourceLimit/dxf-retained-byte-budget before either callback
Raising the same facade to the measured cap permits retry and publishes both callbacks in order

assessment.planImpact: Closes the full-read callback-publication gap for the MLEADER context-text and legacy block-label retained owners. Direct replacement/lease controls remain in the prior selector. DWG storage, consumer-owned copies, serialization, projection, and native semantic gates remain open.
